outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Iran live updates: US strikes multiple Iranian oil tankers, US official says; Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch resigns amid attacks from Trump administration; Lindsay Clancy's lawyer asks Trump to pardon her after mistrial.

items.headline: Iran live updates: US strikes multiple Iranian oil tankers, US official says
items.detail: The Strait of Hormuz remains the primary flashpoint in the conflict.

items.headline: Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch resigns amid attacks from Trump administration
items.detail: Amid attacks from the White House, Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch is stepping down from his position after seven years of leading the Smithsonian Institution.

items.headline: Lindsay Clancy's lawyer asks Trump to pardon her after mistrial
items.detail: Clancy pleaded not guilty to three murder charges for the deaths of her three children.

items.headline: WATCH: Race car driver saves fellow driver from fiery crash
items.detail: ABC News' Will Reeve reports on the heroic race car driver who stopped to rescue a fellow driver whose car was engulfed in flames.

items.headline: WATCH: Summer box office sets record
items.detail: Hollywood has just wrapped up its best summer in a decade and its biggest vibe shift since the pandemic.
